texts: When the Council convenes, the Council redistributes mire-essence across the lantern-stations.
Whenever the Council meets, the Council reallocates mire-essence among the lantern-stations.
Productive stations contribute mire-essence to a central pool.
Burdened stations draw mire-essence from the central pool.
The Keepers record the redistribution in the Watch ledgers.

fields.sentence: When the Council convenes, the Council redistributes mire-essence across the lantern-stations.
parse: (: f93_rule (Implication (And (Member $c convene) (Agent $c sk_council_1)) (And (Member (sk_redistribute $c) redistribute) (Agent (sk_redistribute $c) sk_council_1) (Theme (sk_redistribute $c) mire_essence) (Across (sk_redistribute $c) sk_group_1))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The whenever/when-rule machinery requires the per-occurrence response to be tied to its trigger with During, but this conclusion carries no (During (sk_redistribute $c) $c) atom, which also breaks the prescribed whole-conclusion-bundle query form.

q2_gaps: A habitual/recurring bare-'when P, Q' whose participants are definite and specific: the routing rule sends generic or indefinite participants to the whenever machinery and definite/specific participants *in a one-off narrative* to two plain ordered events, but 'When the Council convenes, the Council redistributes …' is present-habitual with a definite singular subject and falls under neither branch.
review.notes: Across is licensed as a preposition-named oblique, the singular collective 'the Council' correctly gets no distribution rule and no Name atom, and the definite plural 'the lantern-stations' correctly takes a group witness.

issues.reason: The parse adopts the whenever template in full — a Skolem conclusion keyed on the trigger event $c — but drops its one prescribed linking atom ("the response as a Skolem event per occurrence, tied to its trigger with During") even though $c is available and the tie is true here, so the prescribed whole-conclusion-bundle query form cannot match the derived event.

gaps_confirmed: a bare "when P, Q" that is present-habitual with a DEFINITE specific participant fits neither routing branch — generic/indefinite participants go to the whenever machinery, definite ones to two plain ordered events only "in a one-off narrative"
adjudication.defect_summary: Add (During (sk_redistribute $c) $c) as a conjunct of the rule's conclusion; the rest of the rule already matches the whenever template.
adjudication.notes: Across is a licensed preposition-named oblique, the singular collective "the Council" correctly gets no distribution rule and no Name atom, the definite plural takes a group witness, and both compound genera are right. The gap over routing a definite-participant habitual is real but does not excuse the drop: having adopted the template's Skolem-on-trigger shape, its available and true tie atom is simply missing.

fields.sentence: Whenever the Council meets, the Council reallocates mire-essence among the lantern-stations.
parse: (: council_meet_reallocate (Implication (And (Member $e meet) (Agent $e sk_council_1)) (And (Member (sk_reallocate $e) reallocate) (Agent (sk_reallocate $e) sk_council_1) (Theme (sk_reallocate $e) mire_essence) (Among (sk_reallocate $e) sk_stations_1) (During (sk_reallocate $e) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: "The Council" correctly stays a capitalized-common-noun witness with no Name atom and does not distribute (singular collective); the top-level sk_council_1 constant in the rule premise parallels sk_bell_1 in the whenever example, and "among" takes the preposition-named oblique Among with a definite-plural GroupOf witness.

fields.sentence: Productive stations contribute mire-essence to a central pool.
parse: (: prod_stations_contribute (Implication (And (Member $x station) (Member $x productive)) (And (Member (sk_contribute $x) contribute) (Agent (sk_contribute $x) $x) (Theme (sk_contribute $x) mire_essence) (Recipient (sk_contribute $x) sk_pool_1))) (STV 0.9 0.9))

review.notes: The adjectivally-restricted bare-plural kind subject correctly forces the distributing-rule route with "productive" as a premise conjunct (not a fused compound, not a kind relation), at bare-generic 0.9/0.9 with no QuantifierPhrase; compound decomposition is right on both mire_essence (noun modifier unexposed) and central_pool (positional modifier exposed). "A central pool" is read as one shared constant rather than a per-station Skolem — a scope judgment the instruction set permits world knowledge to make, though the default tiebreak would give the subject universal wide scope.

fields.sentence: Burdened stations draw mire-essence from the central pool.
parse: (: station_draw_rule (Implication (And (Member $x station) (Member $x burdened)) (And (Member (sk_draw $x) draw) (Agent (sk_draw $x) $x) (Theme (sk_draw $x) mire_essence) (Source (sk_draw $x) sk_pool_1))) (STV 0.9 0.9))

review.notes: The adjectivally-restricted bare-plural subject correctly forces the distributing-rule route with "burdened" as a premise conjunct rather than a kind-level relation, at the bare-generic (STV 0.9 0.9). The definite "the central pool" is a top-level witness carrying `central` as a separate descriptive atom, and `Source` for "from …" plus `Theme` for the drawn mass are as specified.

fields.sentence: The Keepers record the redistribution in the Watch ledgers.

q1_issues.issue: "The Keepers" is a definite capitalized PLURAL kind-word label, which the instruction set routes to a Name-only individual (one symbol plus a mandatory Name atom, explicitly no GroupOf and no per-member kind from the label word); the parse instead emits (GroupOf sk_keepers_1 keeper) and no Name atom.

review.notes: "The Watch ledgers" is handled well — head phrase parsed normally as a definite-plural group and linked by the opaque Possession, with the capitalized singular label typed as a common noun and no Name atom — and "record" correctly takes Theme (a verb that merely records leaves its object unchanged); (Location sk_record_1 sk_ledgers_1) for "in the ledgers" is a defensible where-reading but sits close to the preposition-named In used for medium/domain "in"-phrases.

issues.reason: *Names and casing* makes a capitalized PLURAL kind-word label a Name-only individual — "one symbol, Name atom, no GroupOf and no per-member kind from the label word (the members need not be wrens; a type atom is never invented)" — so (GroupOf sk_keepers_1 keeper) asserts a member kind the rule forbids, and the mandatory Name atom is absent.

adjudication.defect_summary: Compliant form: a single symbol (e.g. keepers) with (Name keepers "Keepers") and no claim about its members — the GroupOf atom dropped entirely — filling the Agent slot of the record event; the redistribution, Watch-ledger and role atoms are unaffected.
adjudication.notes: (Location sk_record_1 sk_ledgers_1) is a defensible where-reading but competes with the preposition-named In the instruction set uses for a medium ("in a statement"); it was not filed as an issue and does not bear on the decision.
